derivation: from the base of G4982 (σώζω) and that of G4599 (σθενόω);
def: of safe strength; Sosthenes, a Christian

occurrences.text: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.
Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
